name: check_availability
description: Checks whether a table is available for a given party size and requested date/time at Lale Bistro. Always call this before telling the caller a table is or is not available — never guess. If unavailable, the response includes up to three nearby alternative time slots the caller can be offered instead.

party_size.description: Number of guests in the party, 1 to 8. Parties larger than 8 are not handled by this tool; offer human follow-up instead.

requested_time.description: Requested reservation date and time as an ISO 8601 string, e.g. 2026-09-01T19:30:00. No UTC offset means Europe/Istanbul local time.

name: create_reservation
description: Creates a confirmed table reservation at Lale Bistro. Preconditions: call check_availability first and only call this after it returned available=true for the exact same date, time, and party size, AND the caller has explicitly confirmed the repeated-back name, phone number, date, time, and party size out loud. Returns a confirmation_code on success. Safe to retry with the same call automatically — retrying never creates a duplicate reservation.

customer_name.description: Full name of the guest the reservation is under.

phone.description: Guest phone number, any common Turkish format (e.g. 0532 123 45 67). Used later to verify identity for lookups and cancellation.

party_size.description: Number of guests in the party, 1 to 8.

requested_time.description: Confirmed reservation date and time as an ISO 8601 string, e.g. 2026-09-01T19:30:00. No UTC offset means Europe/Istanbul local time.

name: get_reservation
description: Looks up an existing reservation by confirmation_code and the phone number on file. Both must match or nothing is returned. Use this to answer questions about an existing reservation. This lookup alone does not authorize cancellation — cancel_reservation still requires its own explicit confirmation.

confirmation_code.description: Four-character reservation confirmation code (e.g. 7K2Q). Do not add a prefix.

phone.description: Phone number on the reservation, used to verify the caller's identity.

name: cancel_reservation
description: Cancels an existing reservation identified by confirmation_code and the matching phone number. Preconditions: only call this after identity is verified (get_reservation found a match, or the caller supplied both values correctly) AND the caller has explicitly confirmed they want to cancel that specific reservation. This cannot be undone by the assistant.

confirmation_code.description: Four-character reservation confirmation code (e.g. 7K2Q). Do not add a prefix.

phone.description: Phone number on the reservation, used to verify the caller's identity.

name: search_menu
description: Searches the Lale Bistro menu by dish name keyword and/or category. Both parameters are optional; omit both to list menu highlights. Use this to answer menu questions, never invent dishes or prices that aren't returned by this tool.

query.description: Free-text dish name keyword to search for, e.g. 'kebap'. Omit to not filter by name.

category.description: Menu category to filter by, e.g. 'Tatlı' (dessert) or 'Çorba' (soup). Omit to not filter by category.
